newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius shares little changed in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius shares little changed in quiet trading.

text.p: Shares at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius were stable on Monday with the market index ending 0.58 points up at 322.67, in a quiet session, brokers said.
Volume totalled 6.37 million rupees on 383,716 shares from 18.60 million rupees on 1,124,096 shares on Friday with most interest shown in stocks of leading companies.
"Foreign investors again bought stocks of Rogers, Sun Resorts and those in the banking sector as well. This explains the concentration of volume there," a broker said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 73 rupees on 14,511 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 8.50 rupees on 236,500 shares.
Conglomerate Rogers was stable at 92 rupees on 8,715 shares and hotel-based Sun Resorts gained 50 cents to 36 rupees on 28,222 shares.
Smaller deals were seen in the rest of the market, reflecting a continued lack of investor interest, brokers said.
In industrials, Mauritius Breweries was up a rupee to 125 on 1,312 shares and Mauritius Stationery Manufacturers (MSM) was unchanged at 46.30 rupees on 4,400 shares.
Investment stocks Promotion And Development (PAD) added 10 cents to 16.10 rupees on 2,000 shares and Policy was 20 cents higher to 3.70 rupees on 29,625 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert rose 50 cents to 33.60 rupees on 50 shares and Savannah (ordinary) remained at 120 rupees on 889 shares.
Commerce-based Courts (Mauritius) was stable at 3.80 rupees on 10,204 shares and New Mauritius Hotels was unchanged at 28 rupees on 5,100 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius remained at 50.50 rupees on 745 shares.
